title: Military Service Hold Extensions — Carry by Extension Number
content:
**Military desk schedule — Hardship and Protective Holds.** The carry of a service extension of a Military Service Hold depends on how many further extensions the tier will still allow once this one is booked, counting the extensions already granted on the hold (the extension grants recorded in the hold's history). The Military Service Hold allows 3 extensions per hold, so the further extensions remaining are 3, less the extensions already granted, less the one being booked.

| Further extensions remaining once this one is booked | Carry added |
|---|---|
| None | The tier's post-service protection days, 90 calendar days, so that the last extension also covers the period after active duty ends |
| Exactly one | The penultimate carry, 15 calendar days |
| Two or more | Nothing |

## By extension number

| Extensions already granted on the hold | This booking is the | Further remaining afterwards | Carry |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | First extension | 2 | Nothing |
| 1 | Second extension | 1 | 15 days |
| 2 | Third extension | 0 | 90 days |

The carry is added once to the days the service extension adds.

**Example (hypothetical).** A servicemember whose hold history shows one extension already granted books another: one further extension will remain, so 15 calendar days are carried.
